race.comment: ROCK THE MARKET (6) couldn't bring up the hat-trick last start when missing by 1.7L in this grade last time out. A better barrier this time can see him sit a touch closer with Brad Parnham reuniting with the mare. She continues to improve with racing and can get back to winning ways with this set-up. REMINISCENCE (9) threw up a poor one last start after looming large on straightening a fortnight ago. Pike hops off, but it was only 1 poor run and he's a colt with plenty of upside still. Happy to overlook one poor effort and he can bounce back in a big way. PANTILE WARRIOR (1) is a Victorian stayer resuming for Team Williams on the back of some impressive trials coming in. Pike rides which is a big push for his chances and if he can pick up from where he left off last campaign, he'll be right in the finish. CONDUCIVE (8) was too good last start on the quick turnaround and has to be included. DELTASON (2) is a handy type with 1400m suiting now. Can go close.
